home.hero.title: The logic behind
home.hero.text: At ILogic Software Solutions, we provide technology solutions that help your company grow. We design websites that attract customers, develop systems to manage your operations, and build smart solutions that improve your team's productivity. Our journey began in competitive global markets. Today, we work in Egypt, serving clients across Egypt and the Middle East with the latest digital solutions.
home.flow.label: We add logic to save time you can invest in growth
home.trust.projects: Live projects in the Russian market
home.trust.region: Serving Egypt and the Middle East
home.story.title: Our name is our approach
home.story.text: We build every system with clear logic. Every page has a purpose and every step has a reason: to save you time and make purchasing easier for your customers.
home.story.identity: We are a software company that uses logic to save time.
home.story.services: We build systems that save business owners time and make selling to their customers easier. Our multidisciplinary team designs websites and online stores, develops ERP and CRM systems, and automates daily operations.
home.story.innovators: Through the ILogic Partners Program, we help creators develop promising systems, add new capabilities, and bring them to market. A clear agreement defines each team's role and how the system is launched.
home.services.title: Before any design or code, we ask
home.services.web.title: Websites
home.services.web.question: What is the one thing your visitor must do?
home.services.web.text: We start with the answer, then build every page to lead them there. The rest is detail.
home.services.web.alt: Responsive website on desktop and mobile with a development panel
home.services.seo.title: SEO
home.services.seo.question: What happens to your visibility the day you stop paying for ads?
home.services.seo.text: An ad is rented; visibility on Google is built. We build a presence that stays, and gives your customer a reason to trust you before they call.
home.services.seo.alt: Magnifying lens over a search results list with the top result highlighted
home.services.automation.title: Automation & custom systems
home.services.automation.question: Which task does your team repeat every day without thinking?
home.services.automation.text: That is the first task we automate. It is how we built a loyalty system for self-service coffee machines with no cashier: the customer scans a code and the points arrive on their own.
home.services.automation.alt: Automation workflow connecting orders, invoices and devices with automatic confirmation
home.services.security.title: Website & system security
home.services.security.question: Is your website secure… or could it show content that damages your reputation?
home.services.security.text: Injected links or inappropriate content can break a customer's trust in a moment. We find and fix vulnerabilities in your website or system, and configure permissions and updates to reduce the risk of an attack.
home.services.security.alt: A shield and lock protect a website window from malicious links, in soft mint and lavender

home.works.alsherif.title: Al Sherif · Cold room installation website in Egypt
home.works.alsherif.tag: Al Sherif website for cold rooms and insulated panels
home.works.alsherif.problem: Many companies need cold room services but do not know Al Sherif or what it offers.
home.works.alsherif.logic: A search-engine-friendly website that helps potential customers find the company and presents its work professionally to highlight the quality of its installations.
home.works.gostinec.problem: A varied range of hotel and hospitality supplies needs a clear presentation that helps customers find the store when they need it.
home.works.gostinec.logic: An online store with clear product categories, search, product details, and a shopping cart.
home.works.fopac.problem: A manufacturer with a wide range of sizes needed a straightforward way to receive wholesale enquiries.
home.works.fopac.logic: A clear catalog organized by size, an enquiry form, and direct contact by phone and WhatsApp.
home.works.zavodsz.title: ZavodSZ · Steel structure manufacturer in Russia
home.works.zavodsz.problem: Complex engineering products needed to be presented in a way contractors could quickly understand.
home.works.zavodsz.logic: Clear product categories for lightning protection, lighting poles and supports, organized into pages for construction customers.
home.works.loyalty.title: Loyalty system for self-service coffee machines
home.works.loyalty.problem: At a self-service machine, there is no employee to ask for the customer's loyalty card.
home.works.loyalty.logic: The customer scans a QR code before paying. Once the purchase is complete, points are added to their account automatically, with no extra step.
home.works.behavior.title: User behavior analytics system
home.works.behavior.text: A system that analyzes user behavior to understand their interests and needs, helping the institution identify and reach the right customers. We built it for a major banking institution in the Russian market.

home.process.title: Four clear steps
home.process.understand.title: Understand
home.process.understand.text: We ask more questions than you might expect, because a good solution starts with understanding the problem.
home.process.plan.title: Plan
home.process.plan.text: We map the project's structure and logic before designing anything.
home.process.build.title: Build
home.process.build.text: We deliver in stages you can review and refine.
home.process.improve.title: Measure & improve
home.process.improve.text: Launch is the start of the work, not the end.
home.lab.title: Something bigger is taking shape
home.lab.text: Behind the scenes, we are building a connected set of smart systems for businesses and teams. We are keeping the details under wraps for now, but you can be among the first to hear more.

home.partners.visual.alt: A developer and the ILogic team collaborate to develop a system and bring it to its users
home.partners.solution: we help bring it to market
home.partners.text: We support Egyptian and Arab developers. If your ERP, CRM or other system brings an original idea, we review it with you and explore how to develop it and add new capabilities. We also help with marketing, sales and support. Our team's role, the launch approach and the partnership share are agreed transparently with you.
home.faq.title: Before we start
home.faq.cost.question: How much does a company website cost?
home.faq.cost.answer: The cost depends on the number of pages and the features you need. After a short conversation about your requirements, we send a clear proposal with pricing and a timeline before any commitment.
home.faq.seo.question: Do you offer SEO after the website is delivered?
home.faq.seo.answer: Yes. We build websites with a search-friendly structure from the start, and offer ongoing SEO for businesses that want to keep growing their visibility.
home.faq.custom.question: What is the difference between a template and a custom website?
home.faq.custom.answer: Templates are faster and less expensive, but tend to look alike and limit functionality. A custom website is built around your business and goals, and can grow with you.
home.faq.partners.question: How can I submit my system to the partners program?
home.faq.partners.answer: Through the application form on the partners page. We review your system and, if it offers an original solution to a real problem, contact you to agree how we can work together.
home.faq.region.question: Do you work outside Egypt?
home.faq.region.answer: Yes. We serve customers in Egypt and the Middle East, and have live projects in Russia.
home.cta.text: Tell us about your project. We will come back with clear next steps.
